title: Comprehensions: Transforming Data in One Line
concepts: filter with if at the end
conditional expression (if ... else) at the start
when a normal loop is clearer

ai_pair_moment.flaw: Asked to rewrite Asha's loop as a comprehension and keep the output the same, the AI wrote [round(price * 1.1, 2) for name, price, vegan in menu] and promised [3.85, 4.4]. It dropped the filter, so the program prints [3.85, 4.4, 4.68, 3.03]. Adding if vegan at the end fixes it.

changes: List and dictionary comprehensions are taught; set comprehensions appear only as Mistake 1, because curly brackets without a colon are a common slip.
Nested comprehensions and generator expressions are left out of the steps to keep one new idea per step; two for parts appear only in Think beyond.

The AI section adds verified files for each stage: Asha's loop, the AI's refactor without the filter, a run of three test cases, a misplaced if that raises a SyntaxError, the fixed line run on every case again, and a suggestion with curly brackets that fails every case.
outstanding_issues: The error reports show the short file name; on a learner's computer the full path appears instead.
The narration uses a synthetic voice (Kokoro bm_lewis). The owner should watch the video once and flag any word the voice mispronounces; fixes go in the PRONOUNCE list in tools/voice.py.
